notes.title: Update notices and discounts
notes.notes:
We will cap new races and heroes on January 1st
Due to the conflict between the discount time and the first-release discount, we did not discount at the first time during the winter sale, but on January 1st.

notes.title: bug Fix bugs in new units
Update
notes.notes:
I am very sorry for the frequent updates after the game was released, and many issues that the development team did not notice were exposed after the game was launched.

We are working to fix and improve the issues raised as soon as possible, and the development team warmly welcomes players to raise their own questions and ideas.

Please rest assured that we will respond and fix it as soon as possible. As the version stabilizes, the development team will quickly devote all their energy to developing a large amount of new content, such as new heroes, new factions, new enemies, and new gameplay mechanisms.
